Yeah (LCD Soundsystem song) | "Yeah" is a song by American rock band LCD Soundsystem.  It was released as a 12-inch single through DFA Records on January 13, 2004. It was written by band member Pat Mahoney and band frontman James Murphy and was produced by the DFA.  The song was featured on the soundtrack for the video game "FIFA 11" and peaked at number 85 on the French Singles Chart.
